name: Mingling of Clear and Muddy Water at the Junction of the Jing and Wei Rivers
material: Handscroll, silk: tapestry weave; ink and colors; silk: embroidery
summary: This handscroll features a map illustrating the Mingling of Clear and Muddy Water at the Junction of the Jing and Wei Rivers (Jing qing Wei zhuo tu) and a report by the statesman Dong Gao (1704–1818), preceded by an imperial commentary.
